name: Bjarndýrakóngur
body:
BJARNDÝRAKÓNGUR
CR 9

This robust polar bear has shining silvery-white fur save for warm, coppery whiskers on its jowls. A spiraling horn curls up from its forehead, topped with a glowing mote.

XP 6,400
LG Large magical beast
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +20

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 12, flat-footed 19 (+3 Dex, +10 natural, –1 size)
hp 137 (11d10+77)
Fort +14, Ref +10, Will +9
Immune charm, compulsion; Resist cold 10; SR 20

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., swim 30 ft.
Melee 2 claws +20 (1d8+9/19–20 plus grab), gore +20 (1d8+9/19–20/x3 plus lingering light)
Ranged moonbeam +13 touch (4d10
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks powerful charge (gore, 3d8+18), rake (bite +20, 1d8+9)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 11th; concentration +16)

At will—detect evil, light, prestidigitation
3/day—daylight
1/day—cone of cold (DC 19), dispel evil (DC 19), solid fog, sunbeam (DC 21), wall of ice (DC 18)

STATISTICS

Str 29, Dex 17, Con 25, Int 11, Wis 23, Cha 21
Base Atk +11; CMB +21 (+25 grapple); CMD 34 (38 vs. trip)
Feats Combat Casting, Endurance, Improved Critical (claw, gore), Power Attack, Run
Skills Perception +20, Stealth +7 (+11 in icy or snowy areas), Survival +11 (+15 in water or plains), Swim +21; Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth in icy or snowy areas, +4 Survival in water or plains
Languages Celestial, Common, Sylvan
SQ luminous horn, wild empathy +22

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Lingering Light (Su)

A creature damaged by the bjarndýrakóngur’s gore or moonbeam attack sheds dim light like a candle until the end of the bjarndýrakóngur’s next turn. For the duration, the target is dazzled and takes a –20 penalty on all Stealth checks. Outlined creatures do not benefit from the concealment normally provided by darkness (though a 6th-level or higher magical darkness effect functions normally), blur, displacement, invisibility, or similar effects.

Luminous Horn (Su)

The bjarndýrakóngur’s horn sheds light like a torch and its gore attack is treated as a magic good weapon for the purposes of damage reduction. The bjarndýrakóngur can extinguish or rekindle this light as a swift action. While this light is extinguished, the bjarndýrakóngur can’t use their moonbeam attack.

Moonbeam (Su)

The bjarndýrakóngur can fire a beam of chilling light with a range of 90 feet that deals 4d10 points of cold damage.

Wild Empathy (Su)

This works like the druid’s wild empathy class feature, except the bjarndýrakóngur has a +6 racial bonus on the check.

ECOLOGY

Environment cold coastlines or plains
Organization solitary or court (1–2 with 2–6 polar bears)
Treasure standard

This king of the polar bears is identified by the long, sharp horn in the center of its forehead. The tip of the horn shines with a bright light. The bjarndýrakóngur is 6 feet tall at the shoulder, 12 feet long, and weighs at least 4,000 pounds.

A bjarndýrakóngur imbues animals it meets, especially bears, with an uncommon instinct toward cooperation and civility. Yet the bjarndýrakóngur insists polar bears it encounters should follow its good example to its own satisfaction. Violators who kill livestock or attack innocent humanoids are punished violently. By the same token, humanoids who kill innocent bears are given no quarter.
